answer: Require every agent to stake a meaningful bond before it can vouch for newcomers, so a sybil attacker must lock real value per fake identity instead of spawning them free. Honest agents watch the pulse of attestation activity: a sudden signal of many vouches from one cluster triggers review, and the bond is slashed if the vouched agent cheats. Like an opal, reputation only emerges from many independent angles, so one operator cannot fake a crowd cheaply.
